item.title: Classic PC demoscene productions running natively in the browser
item.description:

item.title: Dat-ecosystem: high level applications built on top of P2P protocols
Why were Victorian elites so effective?
item.description:
📝 Progressives think that education should prioritize acquiring skills, that it should embrace ‘soft’ subjects beyond the supposed academic core, and that students should be given wide freedom in which to develop personally and socially. Most students at both preparatory and public schools were boarders, meaning that elite Victorians were generally sent away from home by the age of eight and spent their childhoods more with peers than with family. Perhaps the powerful ties of nostalgia and loyalty that students felt for their former schoolmates were linked to this.
🔗 Read more: https://worksinprogress.co/issue/the-seven-vices-of-highly-effective-victorians/
